extracted.intended_audience: DoD contracting officers, acquisition personnel, procurement counsel, and contractors performing or administering commercial product/service and COTS contracts
extracted.subtask_description: Final rule amending the DFARS to clarify which solicitation provisions and contract clauses apply to commercial products, commercial services, and commercially available off-the-shelf (COTS) items, implementing NDAA requirements and a change to 10 U.S.C. 3452(b)(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: NDAA section 849 elimination requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: DoD must review DFARS and propose revisions to eliminate certain contract clause requirements applicable to FAR part 12 commercial product and commercial service acquisitions, and to COTS item subcontracts, except for regulations required by law or Executive order, unless the Secretary of Defense determines a specific reason not to eliminate the regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating whether to retain a DFARS provision/clause for commercial acquisitions, consider procurement-related reasons including, but not limited to: national security, common commercial practice, domestic preference, prohibited sources, trade agreements, protection of the Government, health and safety, and foreign military sales requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of 10 U.S.C. 3452(b)(2) (date-based exclusion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amend DFARS to eliminate solicitation provisions and contract clauses enacted after October 13, 1994 from commercial product and commercial service solicitations and contracts, unless the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment makes a written determination that excluding them would not be in the best interest of DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exclusions do not apply to provisions or clauses referred to in 10 U.S.C. 3452(e)(1), (e)(2), and (e)(3). This change implements paragraph (a) of section 837 of the NDAA for FY 2019 (revising the date to Oct 13, 1994).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inapplicability of listed clauses to COTS items (DFARS 212.371 additions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain provisions and clauses published after October 13, 1994, not expressly authorized in law, are not applicable or are modified in applicability to contracts for the acquisition of COTS items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically added as not applicable (or modified) for COTS: 252.204-7008 (Compliance with Safeguarding Covered Defense Information Controls), 252.204-7012 (Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting), 252.204-7019 (Notice of NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements), 252.204-7020 (NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements), 252.204-7021 (CMMC Requirements), and 252.205-7000 (Provision of Information to Cooperative Agreement Holders).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inapplicability of certain provisions/clauses to commercial products and services (DFARS 212.370 additions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Add specific provisions/clauses to the list of those inapplicable to contracts and subcontracts for the acquisition of commercial products, commercial services, and COTS items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This rule amends 212.370 to add: (b) 252.203-7003, Agency Office of the Inspector General; and (c) 252.215-7007, Notice of Intent to Resolicit, as inapplicable to commercial acquisitions as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.205-7000 (Provision of Information to Cooperative Agreement Holders)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.205-7000 in solicitations and contracts, including solicitations and contracts using FAR part 12 procedures for commercial products and commercial services, except for solicitations and contracts solely for acquisition of COTS items, that are expected to exceed $1.5 million.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This clause implements 10 U.S.C. 4957. It is explicitly excluded for COTS-only solicitations/contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.204-7012 (Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.204-7012 as prescribed in 204.7304(c) to comply with section 941 of the NDAA for FY2013 and section 1632 of the NDAA for FY2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although required to comply with NDAA provisions, the final rule amends 212.371 to clarify that 252.204-7012 is not applicable to contracts solely for acquisition of COTS items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.204-7008 (Compliance with Safeguarding Covered Defense Information Controls)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use provision 252.204-7008 as prescribed in 204.7304(a) to comply with section 941 of the NDAA for FY2013 and section 1632 of the NDAA for FY2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provision related to safeguarding covered defense information; added to the list clarifying applicability to commercial and COTS acquisitions (and to COTS inapplicability list).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.204-7009 (Limitations on Use or Disclosure of Third-Party Contractor Reported Cyber Incident Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.204-7009 as prescribed in 204.7304(b) to comply with section 941 of the NDAA for FY2013 and section 1632 of the NDAA for FY2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clause prescribes limitations on use/disclosure of contractor-reported cyber incident information; included in the 212.301 list of clauses for commercial acquisitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.204-7015 (Notice of Authorized Disclosure of Information for Litigation Support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.204-7015 in solicitations and contracts that involve litigation support services, including solicitations and contracts using FAR part 12 procedures for acquisition of commercial products and commercial services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribed in 204.7403(b) as applicable to litigation support services regardless of FAR part 12 commercial procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.225-7007 (Prohibition on Acquisition of Certain Items from Communist Chinese Military Companies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.225-7007 in solicitations and contracts, including those using FAR part 12 procedures for commercial products and commercial services, involving delivery of items covered by the U.S. Munitions List or the 600 series of the Commerce Control List, unless an exception in 225.770-3 applies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amended prescription at 225.1103(4) to add requirement to include clause in FAR part 12 solicitations/contracts when applicable to listed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.225-7016 (Restriction on Acquisition of Ball and Roller Bearings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.225-7016 as prescribed in 225.7009-5 to comply with section 8065 of Public Law 107-117 and the same restriction in subsequent DoD appropriations acts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the 212.301(f)(x)(J)–(L) list of clauses to be used for commercial acquisitions where statutory requirements apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.225-7017 and 252.225-7018 (Photovoltaic Devices and Certificate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.225-7017 and provision 252.225-7018 as prescribed to comply with section 846 of the NDAA for FY2011 regarding photovoltaic devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These items appear in the DFARS 212.301 list prescribing their use for applicable commercial acquisitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.225-7029 (Acquisition of Uniform Components for Afghan Military or Afghan National Police)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.225-7029 as prescribed in 225.7703-4(d) to comply with section 826 of the NDAA for FY2013.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One respondent recommended removal as obsolete; DoD responded that the clause cannot be removed until the underlying statutory requirement is repealed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.225-7039 (Defense Contractors Performing Private Security Functions Outside the United States)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.225-7039 as prescribed in 225.302-6 to comply with section 862 of the NDAA for FY2008.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among clauses that may still be prescribed for commercial acquisitions when statute requires.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.226-7002 (Representation for Demonstration Project for Contractors Employing Persons with Disabilities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use provision 252.226-7002 as prescribed in 226.7203 to comply with section 853 of the NDAA for FY2004.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicability is preserved where statute requires the representation in commercial acquisitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.237-7010 (Prohibition on Interrogation of Detainees by Contractor Personnel)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.237-7010 as prescribed in 237.173-5 to comply with section 1038 of the NDAA for FY2010.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribed use applies for applicable solicitations, including where commercial procedures are used if the statutory conditions are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.237-7019 (Training for Contractor Personnel Interacting with Detainees)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.237-7019 as prescribed in 237.171-4 to comply with section 1092 of the NDAA for FY2005.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies where statute requires training obligations for contractors involved with detainees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.246-7004 (Safety of Facilities, Infrastructure, and Equipment for Military Operations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.246-7004 as prescribed in 246.270-4 to comply with section 807 of the NDAA for FY2010.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the list of clauses that remain applicable to commercial acquisitions when necessary to satisfy statutory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.247-7003 (Pass-Through of Motor Carrier Fuel Surcharge Adjustment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use clause 252.247-7003 as prescribed in 247.207 to comply with section 884 of the NDAA for FY2009.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clause applies in appropriate commercial solicitations/contracts as required by statute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.247-7026 (Evaluation Preference for Use of Domestic Shipyards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use provision 252.247-7026 as prescribed in 247.574(c) to comply with section 1017 of the NDAA for FY2007, applicable to acquisition of carriage by vessel for DoD cargo in coastwise or noncontiguous trade.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provision remains prescribed for applicable commercial procurements where the statutory conditions apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 252.215-7007 (Notice of Intent to Resolicit) in short competitive solicitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use provision 252.215-7007, Notice of Intent to Resolicit, in competitive solicitations that will be solicited for fewer than 30 days, unless an exception at 215.371-4 applies or the requirement is waived in accordance with 215.371-5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 215.371-6 prescribes use; 212.370 and 212.371 amendments also address this provision's inapplicability in certain commercial contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: 215.371-4 Exceptions include FAR part 12 commercial acquisitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Additions to 215.371-4 clarify that acquisitions of commercial products and commercial services using FAR part 12 procedures are exceptions to certain requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically, paragraph (a)(7) was added identifying acquisitions using FAR part 12 procedures as exceptions to 215.371 requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prescribe 252.203-7003 when FAR 52.203-13 included (203.1004)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the clause at 252.203-7003, Agency Office of the Inspector General, in solicitations and contracts that include the FAR clause 52.203-13, Contractor Code of Business Ethics and Conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prescription was revised to clarify when 252.203-7003 must be used (i.e., tied to inclusion of FAR 52.203-13).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoration of 252.203-7005 applicability to commercial acquisitions
rubrics_metrics.description: DFARS 212.301 is amended to restore DFARS clause 252.203-7005, Representation Relating to Compensation of Former DoD Officials, to the list of provisions and clauses that apply to commercial products and commercial services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This change aligns the final rule with a prior DFARS final rule (DFARS Case 2010-D020).

rubrics_metrics.name: General statement on burden reduction and no new clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rule does not create new solicitation provisions or contract clauses; it clarifies applicability and may reduce burden by making certain provisions/clauses no longer applicable to commercial product/service and COTS solicitations/contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DoD expects potential burden reduction for contractors; the rule clarifies inapplicability lists rather than adding substantive new obligations. The rule was assessed under Regulatory Flexibility Act and Paperwork Reduction Act; no new information collections were added.
